tasks.final_text: The men's singles was a tennis event held as part of the tennis program at the 1904 Summer Olympics. It was the third time the event was held at the Olympics. There were 27 competitors from 2 nations. The event was won by Beals Wright, with the Americans sweeping the medals.

Lentil soup is one of my favorite dishes, especially because I associate it with my local Turkish restaurant. I have many memories of going to Cafe Nur after school and picking up multiple boxes of the soup, which was handmade every day. The owners of the restaurant knew us so well that they'd start making lentil soup ready the second we walked in, and would often give us extra pita and desserts on the side.
